description: This PHP class, LDAPSyncStatusDecorator, acts as a decorator for the LDAPSyncStatus entity, providing methods to set linked user information and retrieve formatted synchronization timestamps, leveraging helper traits for ORM operations and date-time formatting.

classes.name: LDAPSyncStatusDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class that wraps around LDAPSyncStatus entity to provide additional functionality such as setting synced user and retrieving formatted sync timestamps.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with an LDAPSyncStatus entity.

methods.name: setSyncedUserByUserId
methods.description: Associates a User entity, identified by userId, with the LDAPSyncStatus as the user who performed the sync.

methods.name: getSyncStartedDate
methods.description: Returns the sync start date formatted as a string, or null if not available.

methods.name: getSyncStartedTime
methods.description: Returns the sync start time formatted as a string, or null if not available.

methods.name: getSyncFinishedDate
methods.description: Returns the sync finish date formatted as a string, or null if not available.

methods.name: getSyncFinishedTime
methods.description: Returns the sync finish time formatted as a string, or null if not available.
